URL: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/security-guard-rescued-venezuela-earthquake-rubble-8-days/

CBS/AFP (scraped, ~14:30 BST): security guard Hernan Gil rescued from collapsed seven-storey building Catia La Mar eight days after 24 June twin quakes (7.2/7.5); teams from seven countries over three days; Bukele: 'WE FINALLY MANAGED TO RESCUE HERNÁN!'; toll 2,295 dead, 11,000+ injured, ~13,000 homeless (Jorge Rodriguez); seven days of mourning (Delcy Rodriguez); WFP m appeal; NASA ~58,870 buildings damaged. Corroborated: The Times https://www.thetimes.com/world/latin-america/article/venezuela-earthquake-death-toll-rescue-3bqcwdvqc
